$comment: Machine-readable form of Appendix A of method-spec-v2-solana.md.

Everything except v1.records is synthetic and needs no network: keys are Ed25519 public keys derived from SHA-256("did:aip solana profile test vector / <label>") as private seeds, record addresses come from `solana find-program-derived-address`, card hashes are SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of agentCardBody.
registry is a test program id, not a deployed program. Vectors for the deployed square_registry are added when it has an id (BC-09).
v1.records is a snapshot of Solana devnet, not a fixture: v1 records are mutable and may be closed. A test that asserts them must read the chain.

keys.label: vault-b (PDA of wallet program, seeds ["vault", owner-b])

didKeyDecoding.$comment: A did:key decoder must strip the multibase prefix "z" before base58-decoding, then check and drop the 0xed01 multicodec prefix. Decoding "z6Mk…" whole and dropping two bytes (covenant app/lib/aip/did.ts resolveDID, did.slice(8)) returns naiveWrongResult instead of publicKey.

derivation.$comment: agentRecord = find_program_address(["agent", registrant, agent_id], registry). The DID uses the record address, never the slug.

valid.$comment: Mainnet. The same program id and seeds give the same record address on every cluster; only chain-ref tells the two apart, so this is a different DID from the devnet one.
Well-formed. Whether it resolves depends on the resolver having a testnet endpoint; without one the result is unsupportedChain, not invalidDid.
Four segments, namespace eip155: parsed and resolved per method-spec-v2 §3.2, not by this profile.
Two segments: v1 (method-spec-v2 §9.1). The example DID of the v1 specification.
Two segments: v1. A live devnet record, see v1.records.

five segments: the owner-scoped slug is not the agent identifier; the record address is

documents.$comment: Inline resolution cases at a fixed slot. record is the logical AgentRecord view of §4.1; agentCardBody is what the card URI serves (null: unreachable).

cases.name: active-verified-card
cases.$comment: Owner and agent wallet are the same on-curve key: both verification methods are present (method-spec-v2 §4.6 applies). The card hash matches, so card services are emitted; the DID self-reference is dropped.

cases.name: off-curve-wallet-and-slug-collision
cases.$comment: The agent wallet is a program-derived address (standing in for a smart-account vault): it has no private key, so it is not a verification method; it stays visible in didDocumentMetadata.agentWallet. A card service named "Agent Card" slugs to the reserved #agent-card and becomes #agent-card-2. The DID entry naming the v1 predecessor is not a self-reference and is kept.

cases.name: card-hash-mismatch
cases.$comment: The served card differs from the one whose hash is on-chain. Nothing from the card is used; #agent-card stays because the URI itself is on-chain state.

warnings.message: SHA-256 of https://scribe.example/.well-known/aip-card.json does not match agent_card_hash

cases.name: card-unreachable
cases.$comment: agentCardBody null means the URI could not be dereferenced. A warning, not an error.

cases.name: card-invalid
cases.$comment: The served bytes match agent_card_hash, so the owner committed to them, but they are not a valid agent card (§5.5). Nothing from the card is used.

warnings.message: https://scribe.example/.well-known/aip-card.json matches agent_card_hash but is not a valid agent card

cases.name: off-curve-owner-no-card
cases.$comment: The registrant and owner is a program-derived address (an institution's smart-account vault): no #owner verification method, so authentication and capabilityInvocation are empty; control is exercised on-chain through the owning program. The agent wallet is an ordinary key. No card.

cases.name: registry-deactivated
cases.$comment: status = deactivated is authoritative: the record is kept as a tombstone and the document carries no keys or services.

cases.name: card-declares-inactive
cases.$comment: The card sets active: false. That is a claim by the owner, reversible by editing a file: the document is unchanged and the metadata says who deactivated.

cases.name: transferred-owner
cases.$comment: Ownership moved from the registrant (owner-a) to owner-b. The record address, and so the DID, still derive from the registrant; controller and #owner follow the current owner.

v1.$comment: did:aip v1 on Solana devnet, program CgchXu2dRV3r9E1YjRhp4kbeLLtv1Xz61yoerJzp1Vbc. The live account layout is dr-wilson-empty/aip-beta c427872 (1366 bytes), not the wienerlabs/aip-beta 9655c15 copy (1048 bytes).

specExample.$comment: Appendix A.1 of the v1 specification names this derivation but gives no value.
